events.title: Pedro Álvares Cabral reaches the coast of Brazil
events.description: A Portuguese fleet bound for India sighted land in South America and claimed it for Portugal. The landfall began Portuguese colonisation of what became Brazil, long inhabited by Indigenous peoples.
events.html: A Portuguese fleet bound for India sighted land in South America and claimed it for Portugal. The landfall began Portuguese colonisation of what became Brazil, long inhabited by Indigenous peoples.

events.title: Hernán Cortés lands at Veracruz
events.description: Cortés landed on the Gulf coast of Mexico and soon founded Villa Rica de la Vera Cruz. The settlement served as his base for the conquest of the Aztec Empire.
events.html: Cortés landed on the Gulf coast of Mexico and soon founded Villa Rica de la Vera Cruz. The settlement served as his base for the conquest of the Aztec Empire.

events.title: Coinage Act puts 'In God We Trust' on US coins
events.description: Congress authorised a new two-cent coin, the first to bear the motto 'In God We Trust'. It spread to other coins and became the official US national motto in 1956.
events.html: Congress authorised a new two-cent coin, the first to bear the motto 'In God We Trust'. It spread to other coins and became the official US national motto in 1956.

events.title: Germany releases chlorine gas at Ypres
events.description: German troops released chlorine from cylinders against French and Algerian positions near Ypres. It was the first large-scale use of lethal gas on the Western Front and opened a chemical arms race.
events.html: German troops released chlorine from cylinders against French and Algerian positions near Ypres. It was the first large-scale use of lethal gas on the Western Front and opened a chemical arms race.

events.title: Millions mark the first Earth Day
events.description: Some 20 million Americans joined rallies and teach-ins for the first Earth Day. Its momentum helped create the Environmental Protection Agency later that year.
events.html: Some 20 million Americans joined rallies and teach-ins for the first Earth Day. Its momentum helped create the Environmental Protection Agency later that year.

intl.name: Earth Day
intl.description: First held in 1970 following the Santa Barbara oil spill, Earth Day mobilises over a billion people each year to take action on environmental protection, climate change, and biodiversity loss.
